# SourceRadar

> Curated China-first product intelligence for US/EU e-commerce buyers. Each
> pick is proven on the China side (Douyin momentum, 1688 factory pricing)
> and verified on the Western side against daily Google Trends momentum,
> then scored on the numbers that decide a purchase order: factory-vs-retail
> price spread (1688 vs Alibaba vs Western retail), lifecycle stage, landed
> cost under 2026 US tariffs, and required compliance certifications.
> Trends data refreshes daily from Google Trends; picks are hand-curated,
> never auto-generated. Part of the AGI Scorecard site family.

- [Sourcing margins](https://source.agiscorecard.com/sourcing-margins): first-party margin spread computed from all 31 curated picks — conservative median 1.9x with 17 of 31 under 2x, optimistic median 7.9x, plus the first-order cash each MOQ actually requires. Regenerated from the pick dataset, so it cannot drift from it.
- [Radar picks](https://source.agiscorecard.com/#picks): current curated product list with three-tier pricing
- [Why not Alibaba](https://source.agiscorecard.com/#difference): what this adds over marketplace browsing and ad-spy tools
- [Buyer playbook](https://source.agiscorecard.com/#playbook): landed-cost and compliance checklist for first-time importers
- [China to US landed cost 2026](https://source.agiscorecard.com/landed-cost): the duty stack after the Supreme Court struck down the IEEPA tariffs (2026-02-20) — HTS base + Section 301 + Section 232 + MPF/HMF, with de minimis suspended indefinitely for every mode (CBP notices, 2026-06-24). The postal $80–$200 flat duty expired 2026-02-28 and the ~54%/$100 courier rule died with the IEEPA orders; both are listed on the page only as superseded figures. Calculator and dated sources.
- [Is Alibaba legit in 2026?](https://source.agiscorecard.com/is-alibaba-legit): the platform is real, the risk is seller-level — documented scam patterns (cloned Gold Suppliers, virtual-office factories) and the independent verification checklist.
- [Opportunity packs](https://source.agiscorecard.com/packs): weekly paid JSON packs of product-opportunity dossiers (rising query, request recurrence counts, existing supply, matched curated pick); free sample at /packs/sample.json; derived data only.
- [MCP server for agents](https://source.agiscorecard.com/mcp): six keyless tools over the same official record — duty_stack_rules, check_import_claim (the $800 de minimis and three other superseded figures), landed_cost (refuses to guess your duty rate), duty_passport (USITC candidate headings), section_301_ladder (77 chapter-99 headings with their 7.5–100% additions and the U.S. note that defines each list), recall_check (CPSC). JSON-RPC at /api/mcp, plain GET at /api/mcp/<tool>.
